title: Integrate INT8 weight-only GPTQ/AWQ profiles into hybrid canary + telemetry regression
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add an end-to-end integration and regression pipeline for INT8 weight-only quantization profiles produced by GPTQ and AWQ toolchains. This ticket focuses on harmonizing profile metadata, shipping runtime compatibility checks, adding a lightweight hybrid canary that exercises latency/accuracy trade-offs, and surfacing telemetry & golden-seed diffs to detect silent accuracy regressions. This work is meant to complement the nightly calibration suites and the existing profile registry: it targets fast feedback for PRs and deployment canaries rather than full nightly longruns.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible canary job exists that runs GPTQ and AWQ-derived INT8 weight-only profiles against the curated prompt set (~200 prompts) in under 30 minutes
Automated golden-seed answer diff is computed and stored for each profile run with a human-readable delta summary and a numeric AUC/EM metric
Canary emits the following telemetry: percent-of-requests with answer-diff > threshold, per-model-token-perf, and per-profile latency distribution to the dashboard
CI gates on PRs that modify quantization profile serialization or runtime loading with a failing canary mark the PR as blocked
Rollback playbook exists and is tested in a dry-run (documented steps + example ops scripts)
implementation_notes: Profiles: canonicalize GPTQ/AWQ profile fields to a minimal schema (versioned) so runtime can choose kernel/scale parameters deterministically
Runtime: add a lightweight compatibility check that verifies expected tensor layout + per-channel scales before accepting a profile into canary pool
CI: add a short-mode canary to PR pipeline (runs only when PR touches /profiles or runtime loader code) that reuses the golden-seed harness
Orchestration: the canary job uses a small heterogeneous fleet (1-2 GPU types) to detect HW-specific numerical drift
Metrics: emit metrics with tags {profile_id, quant_tool=GPTQ|AWQ, model_family, hw_type} for downstream slicing
Golden-seed: store answer snapshots in a compressed artifact bucket and compute diffs with NLP-aware normalization (strip punctuation, normalize whitespace, token-level alignment)
test_plan: Unit tests for profile schema validation and backward compatibility (existing profile v1 -> v2 conversions)
Integration test that loads GPTQ/AWQ profile into runtime in a sandbox and runs a 50-prompt smoke to validate no crashes and expected latency bounds
Canary e2e: run curated 200-prompt suite and collect metrics; compare against saved golden answers and ensure 'answer-delta-rate' < 1.5% for baseline models
Fuzz: randomize calibration seeds for 3 runs and ensure nondeterministic drift stays within tolerated envelope
Performance regression: measure median p95 latency token generation across profiles and assert no >10% regression vs baseline profile on same hardware
Chaos: inject minor memory pressure on canary node to verify graceful failure and reporting
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (staging): enable canary for profiles produced by a synthetic GPTQ/AWQ pipeline; run nightly for 3 days
Phase 1 (PR-level): gate PRs touching profile code to run the short-mode canary; if two consecutive PR canaries fail, block merge
Phase 2 (canary pool): enable canary for 5% production traffic routing to INT8 profiles behind runtime feature flag and monitor metrics for 72 hours
Phase 3 (ramp): if no regression signals for 72 hours, increase to 25% then to 100% for eligible workload classes
Final: mark profile as 'registry-ready' and move to nightly longrun validation for permanent adoption
rollback_plan: If golden-answer-delta-rate exceeds threshold OR latency regressions > 20% AND sustained for 30 minutes: disable canary routing for affected profile_id via runtime config API
Automated fallback: route affected requests to CPU-backed FP16-safe fallback or last-known-good profile variant (profile_id.previous)
Post-incident: collect artifacts (profile JSON, runtime logs, telemetry slices) and trigger postmortem within 72 hours
telemetry: - quant.profile.answer_delta_rate{profile_id=*} by profile_id -> fraction of requests exceeding normalized-string-diff threshold
- Canary overview: show answer_delta_rate, p95 latency, error count with links to snapshot artifacts
- Alert when answer_delta_rate > 2% for 30m OR p95 latency regresses >15% for 15m
